action_bundles.cypher: MATCH (seed:AnatomyNode) WHERE seed.id IN $seed_node_ids MATCH path=(seed)-[:CONTROLS|HAS_POPULATION|LOCATED_IN|MATERIALIZES_AS|MEMBER_OF|PART_OF|PROJECTS_TO_RENDER|PROJECTS_TO_SIMULATION*0..2]-(node:AnatomyNode) WHERE length(path) < 2 OR all(interior IN nodes(path)[1..length(path)] WHERE NOT interior.kind IN ['body', 'system']) WITH node, min(length(path)) AS depth RETURN node.id AS id, node.label AS label, node.kind AS kind, node.materialization AS materialization, depth ORDER BY depth ASC, id ASC LIMIT $max_nodes

controls.rationale: open the right hand for the visible wave
keep fingers relaxed rather than clenched

diagnostic_expectations: right hand opens and curls within the source-backed wave bundle
unsupported knee and invented bone controls are rejected
